C5c-12, the fold-in, the rule written before any write. One pass (pass 15) folds the changes the four finding files list (serial-C5/finding-1 to finding-4) into the account, the propositions, the prose test and the model, starting from serial-C5/head-before-serial.md for the head. No new read and no claim beyond what the findings and the ledgers hold. The room, or a group of rooms, is the actor where the findings say members spoke or acted for it; members stay where the findings say they act apart or the act is a person's. The account states, in a short section, what it answers of the contract's two questions. Keep copies: account.md as account-p8.md, propositions.jsonl as propositions-p9.jsonl and c5_propositions.json as c5_propositions-p9.json, before they are rewritten. The model takes one further change the findings named: A16's mechanism says the reason comes in written replies (F-014 as superseded). The criterion is read at the end.
